text: にんげんが　うまれる　まえから　この　あたりには　ポケモンが　すんでた　らしいぜ

structure.jp: にんげんが　うまれる　まえから
ポケモンが　すんでた　らしいぜ

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい after a sentence says it is something the speaker heard, not something he knows first-hand. すんでた　らしい = 'apparently they were living here'.

patterns.name: 〜まえ
patterns.span: うまれる　まえから
patterns.explanation: A plain verb followed by まえ means 'before doing that', and から adds 'since'. うまれる　まえから = 'since before (they) were born'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says a state keeps going; すんでた is the casual short form of すんでいた. すんでた = 'were living'.
